name: Star of Mine
source:
This game follows Marie, a 5th grade girl with a very shy nature. She takes comfort in her hobbies, primarily drawing a particular character of her own creation. While she finds enjoyment in creating, she is more reluctant about sharing her works.  Can you really keep any insecurities hidden from middle schoolers, though? 

[From [url=https://onedoveabove.itch.io/star-of-mine-demo] itch.io[/url]]
